title: Bulgaria wins 2026 Eurovision, Israel lands a nail-biting second
facts: Bulgaria won the 70th Eurovision Song Contest held at the Wiener Stadthalle in Vienna, Austria.
Darina Yotova, known as Dara, won the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest with the song 'Bangaranga'.
Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest for the first time in the country's history.
Bulgaria won the Eurovision final with a total of 516 points.
Israel finished in second place in the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest with 343 points.
Noam Bettan represented Israel at Eurovision 2026 with the multilingual song 'Michelle'.
Romania finished in third place at Eurovision 2026 with 296 points.
Broadcasters from Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Iceland, and Slovenia boycotted the 2026 Eurovision final over Israel's participation.
Austrian singer Johannes Pietsch, known as JJ, presented the Eurovision winner's trophy to Dara.
JJ opened the Eurovision 2026 final singing the 'Queen of the Night' aria from Mozart's opera 'The Magic Flute'.
Finnish duo Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen competed in the final with the song 'Liekinheitin'.
Romanian singer Alexandra Căpitănescu performed the heavy metal entry 'Choke Me' in the final.
Australian singer Delta Goodrem finished in fourth place with the song 'Eclipse'.
Atanas Pekanov serves as Deputy Prime Minister of Bulgaria.
Eurovision organizers revised voting regulations in 2026 following allegations of state-backed lobbying in previous editions.
